signal_definitions.momentum_20d: trailing 20-trading-day return ending at the Friday-of-week-t close, no skip
signal_definitions.momentum_60d: trailing 60-trading-day return ending at the Friday-of-week-t close, no skip
signal_definitions.momentum_126d: trailing 126-trading-day return ending at the Friday-of-week-t close, no skip
signal_definitions.momentum_12_1m: cumulative return from t-252 to t-21 trading days (12 months back to 1 month back), skipping the most recent 21 trading days

ranking: descending; high signal = high momentum = Q1 = BUY, low signal = Q5 = AVOID
universe: Full Sharadar domestic common stocks, PIT eligibility (>=$500K/day median dollar volume, >=252 trading days history, min price $1), excluding Finance/Insurance/Real Estate. Healthcare excluded only if the Sloan accruals fix (Track A) is carried forward into a shared universe -- not applied here since momentum has no reason inherited from that diagnosis; left to whichever sector list is passed to load_universe_candidates at run time.
execution_note: Signal formed and position executed at the same Friday close (no Monday-open gap modeled). Held returns are Friday-close-to-next-Friday-close.
cost_note: Applied to the Q1 (long) leg's one-way weekly turnover (symmetric-difference-of-holdings convention), annualized as weekly_turnover * 0.0010 * 52.

falsification_criteria.momentum_20d: PASSES if long-short alpha t>2.58 AND long-only small-cap alpha t>2.0 AND UMD loading<0.5; SUGGESTIVE if 2.0<t<2.58 or long-only alpha positive but t<2.0; FALSIFIED if long-short t<2.0 or UMD loading>0.8. Additionally expected weakest/reversed given short-term-reversal overlap.

falsification_criteria.cost_sensitive_override: Any horizon that otherwise PASSES or is SUGGESTIVE, but whose annualized cost estimate exceeds 3%/yr, is reclassified COST_SENSITIVE -- report, do not advance until the cost model is refined.
